test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

He _______ any food until he finishes his homework.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence uses the future tense with the negative form 'will not get'.
 
• The other options 'has not get', 'gets not', and 'gotten' are** grammatically incorrect** in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'will not get'.
